name: Leg Press Calf Raise
summary: An isolation exercise using a leg press machine to train the calves through loaded ankle plantarflexion.

setup: Sit securely in the leg press seat with your back and hips firmly supported against the pads.
Place the balls of your feet along the bottom edge of the sled platform about hip-width apart, allowing your heels to hang free off the edge.
Extend your legs to unlock the safety handles, keeping a very slight, soft bend in the knees rather than hyperextending them.
steps: Slowly lower the platform by flexing your ankles, letting your heels drop into a deep, controlled stretch.
Pause briefly at the bottom to eliminate elastic bounce.
Press through the balls of your feet to push the platform away into maximal plantarflexion.
Hold the peak contraction for a brief pause before lowering under control.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you press onto your toes; inhale smoothly as your heels drop into the stretch.

common_faults.fault: Bending and straightening the knees to move the weight.
common_faults.correction: Keep your knee angle locked in a soft extension so all movement occurs strictly at the ankle joint.

common_faults.fault: Allowing the balls of the feet to slip off the bottom edge.
common_faults.correction: Ensure a solid purchase with the metatarsal heads firmly anchored on the lower platform before unlatching the sled.

common_faults.fault: Bouncing quickly out of the bottom position.
common_faults.correction: Descend under control and pause for one second at full dorsiflexion to prioritize calf hypertrophy over Achilles tendon recoil.

precautions: Always keep safety stops adjusted high enough to catch the sled if your feet slip off the edge.
Never aggressively hyperextend your knees under load.
